hardConstraintNote: This move does not suggest probe forms or claim orderings; these are determined externally.
rationale: The narrative currently lacks a clear explanation for why the practice of 'naming' is so vital and what happens when names are lost or forgotten. This creates a disconnect between the stated importance of naming and its practical demonstration within the story. Extending a tongue allows for an expositional moment where a character explains the history and significance of naming, addressing this gap.
title: The Name That Died / Carry Your Own Names / The Portable Proof-of-Understanding Workshop
